title: Existence of a Noetherian local model tower
statement: Let $R,S,S\prime$ be commutative local rings with local homomorphisms $R\to S\to S\prime$. Suppose $S$ and $S\prime$ are localizations of finitely presented $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let $M$ be a finitely presented $S\prime$-module, with the restricted $S$- and $R$-actions. Then there exists a Noetherian local model tower [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower] for $R,S,S\prime,M$, with no base- or fibre-flatness assumption and with the universe bounds specified in that definition. This is an existence statement about the entire compatible directed system; it asserts no flatness at any stage.

proof.text: Lift R,S,S′ to the common universe by ULift. Reflect units through the canonical ring equivalences to obtain local structures and local lifted maps. Restrict the P- and Q-algebra base along ULift.down; finite presentation is preserved by composition with a ring equivalence. Transport the two localization presentations to the lifted target rings. Extend the S′-module presentation across the rank-one scalar equivalence ULift S′ ≃ S′. Mathlib Module.FinitePresentation.exists_fin gives a finite free quotient M ≃ (Fin n → ULift S′)/K, and K.fg_iff_exists_fin_linearMap gives a matrix H with range K. Its quotient is therefore linearly equivalent to M. This entire step is proved in Lean, with no new hole.

proof.text: Apply WeilConjectures.limit_tower_essentially_finite_presentation to the lifted ring maps, transported algebra presentations and the constructed matrix presentation of M. This produces the categorical system, with its actual cocones, local and essential finite type assertions, and all transition and limit base-change comparisons.

theorem exists_noetherian_localModelTower
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) (S' : Type w) (M : Type t)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing S']
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalRing S']
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra S S'] [Algebra R S'] [IsScalarTower R S S']
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap S S')]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module S' M] [Module S M] [Module R M]
    [IsScalarTower S S' M] [IsScalarTower R S M]
    (P : Type p) (Q : Type q) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q]
    [Algebra R P] [Algebra P S] [IsScalarTower R P S]
    [Algebra R Q] [Algebra Q S'] [IsScalarTower R Q S']
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R Q]
    (W : Submonoid P) (V : Submonoid Q) [IsLocalization W S] [IsLocalization V S']
    [Module.FinitePresentation S' M] :
    Nonempty (NoetherianLocalModelTower R S S' M)
